workbench.removeConfirm: Remove “{{name}}” from the list? (disk files stay)

commit.noRepoHint: Add one on the Repos tab, or pick from existing repos below
commit.identityMismatch: Current identity differs from the preset (preset: {{preset}})
commit.identityMismatchMulti: {{count}} repos have an identity that differs from the preset:
commit.identityMismatchWarn: “Use preset” applies the preset first, then commits.
commit.discardWarn: Worktree will be restored to the last commit. This cannot be undone.
commit.discardStagedWarn: Both the index and worktree will be restored to the last commit. Unstaged edits on this file are discarded too. This cannot be undone.
commit.discardUntrackedWarn: The untracked file will be permanently deleted.
commit.aheadHint: {{count}} local commit(s) ahead of remote — click Push to sync.
commit.behindHint: Remote is {{count}} commit(s) ahead — pull before pushing.
commit.behindBeforePushWarn: Push may fail (non-fast-forward). Prefer pulling first. Pull is ff-only.
commit.noUpstreamHint: No upstream yet — Push will publish to origin and set tracking.
commit.undoLastConfirm: Undo the latest commit in this repo? Changes stay staged so you can fix and recommit.
commit.undoLastWarn: Affects local history only; worktree changes are kept.
commit.undoLastOk: Last commit undone; changes remain staged
commit.undoLastBlockedRemote: Tip matches remote — cannot undo here (would need force-push)
commit.undoLastRevertConfirm: This commit is already on the remote; a new inverse commit will undo its changes.
commit.undoLastRevertWarn: History is not rewritten, so no force-push is needed and the result pushes like any other commit. The worktree must be clean; conflicts abort automatically.
commit.undoLastRevertHint: Already pushed → creates an inverse commit (no history rewrite)
commit.generateNeedModel: Add a default model in Model Settings first
commit.changelistEmptyUnfavorited: Not favorited — included for this scan only
commit.changelistEmptyHint: Just edited? Confirm the repo path, then Refresh
commit.changelistStatusParseEmpty: Changes detected, but the file list failed to parse. Click Refresh; report if it stays empty.
commit.changelistSameMessageHint: The same commit message will be used for {{count}} repos
commit.changelistPushNeedAhead: No local commits to push (ahead is 0)
commit.changelistDiffHint: Select a file on the left to preview diff
commit.changelistPickRepo: Click a repo in the changelist first
commit.unstagePartialTitle: Partial commit will unstage other files
commit.unstagePartialConfirm: {{count}} staged file(s) are not checked; they will be unstaged before commit so they are not included.
commit.unstagePartialWarn: “Keep staged after commit” re-stages those files after a successful commit.
